purpose: Deterministic research fixture; not an investor-specific tax result or return forecast.

cashflow_fixture.contribution_timing: Illustrative end-of-month schedule; actual payment dates unconfirmed.
cashflow_fixture.transaction_rounding: Not assumed; fixture retains decimal schedule values.

conventions.cash_amount_inr: Finite non-negative magnitude; event_type determines direction. Contributions and income add cash; acquisitions, fees, withholding, and withdrawals use cash; disposals add proceeds less fee.
conventions.event_sequence: Unique integer within each date; controls same-day processing order.
conventions.tax_year: Derived from event_date using the Indian tax year beginning 1 April; mismatch is rejected.
conventions.tax_withholding_inr: Record withholding as a separate withholding event and credit in its event tax year; do not net it against gross income.
conventions.tax_classification: Income needs confirmed ordinary/dividend classification. Positive realized gains need confirmed section76/196/197/198 classification and corresponding eligibility predicate. Unrealized gains are valuation only.
conventions.tax_source_trace: Each portfolio tax-year category and withholding credit must list source event IDs. Each source record carries date, tax year, instrument, classification, rule reference, and lot/acquisition date when lot-linked. Annual tax is calculated at tax-year level and is not allocated across events.
conventions.amount_precision: Decimal arithmetic; no statutory rupee or transaction rounding is applied. Derived unit-price multiplication may retain a computation-only residual up to ₹0.000000000001; residuals above this fail reconciliation.
conventions.capital_gain_loss_trace: Realized capital losses and gains must have source event IDs, lot IDs, tax year, supported tax-bucket/holding character and confirmed eligibility. Every offset is caller-selected and explicitly linked by loss ID to gain ID; no allocation priority is inferred.
conventions.statutory_rounding: The TY 2026-27 tax component applies section 516 total-income and final settlement rounding as implemented and audited. Ledger amounts, unit calculations and transaction costs retain Decimal precision; no investor transaction rounding is inferred.

ledger_event_fields.implemented_ledger_scope: Synthetic event/lot fixtures support positive and negative realized gains, explicitly allocated current-year and evidenced carried-loss offsets within supported tax buckets, and section 516 income/settlement rounding. Unknown classifications, unmatched eligible offsets, aggregate-only external capital gains, pre-2026 transition losses, personal tax facts and future-law assumptions remain blocked/fail-closed.

cases: direct-bond annual coupon and par maturity
terminal_case_fixture.fund_assumption: Synthetic specified-fund lot; 5% per year simple NAV appreciation applied linearly by month, with no distribution stream; positive terminal gain classified under section 76 solely for mechanics testing.
terminal_case_fixture.bond_assumption: Synthetic direct bond purchased at par, annual 5% cash coupon, principal returned at par; no secondary-market sale or accrued-interest price is modeled.
terminal_case_fixture.external_tax_fixture: ₹30 lakh ordinary income explicitly supplied in every tax year containing portfolio income.
terminal_case_fixture.tax_rule_assumption: TY 2026-27 component rules are held constant through the synthetic future tax years; this is not a future-law or personal tax forecast.
terminal_case_fixture.staged_sale_timing: Half of every fund lot is sold at the terminal month-end and the remainder on the following 1 April.
terminal_case_fixture.tax_payment_timing: Tax liabilities are deducted from terminal fixture wealth; interim tax payments and reinvestment effects are not modeled.
terminal_case_fixture.fees: Zero fixture fees; actual product and transaction costs are unconfirmed.
terminal_case_fixture.real_wealth: Not calculated until CPI base and actual cashflow dates are aligned.

unknowns_that_must_not_be_defaulted: investor tax regime, other income, losses, rebate eligibility, and withholding credits
security identifiers, tax classification, acquisition dates, and holding-period eligibility
brokerage, statutory levies, exit loads, and transaction rounding

series_classification.CPI: All-India combined general CPI, 2024 base; linked historical levels Jan-2013 through Dec-2024 and direct 2024-base observations Jan-2025 through Sep-2026; provisional for real-wealth use pending independent observation-level audit and investor base-date alignment.
series_classification.equity: Nifty 500 TRI only when using the identified TRI source file; do not substitute price index.
series_classification.bond: LIC MF Nifty 8-13 Yr G-Sec ETF NAV is an investable fund NAV proxy; not a direct sovereign bond or official G-Sec total-return index.
series_classification.gold_silver: RBI Mumbai monthly bullion averages are bullion observations; not ETF returns.

fail_closed_rules: Unknown instrument or tax eligibility cannot receive an assumed tax rate.
Withholding is a tax credit and is not subtracted as final tax expense.
Unrealized gains are not realized taxable disposals.
Do not publish final real wealth until CPI base and observation alignment are qualified.

capital_loss_schedule.source: decision/capital_gain_loss_schedule.py; sections 108, 111, 121 within the bounded TY 2026-27 review
requirements: source-trace gain and loss to event and lot
explicit caller allocation; no inferred priority
enforce short/long character restrictions and source-gain caps
carried losses require section 263(1) return evidence and use within eight succeeding tax years
apply all mandatory compatible loss offsets before tax
fail_closed: pre-2026 transition losses until a separate section 536 representation is qualified
aggregate-only external capital-gain amounts without event/lot traces
unsupported character/eligibility, missing evidence, invalid/expired carry-forward, incompatible or incomplete eligible allocations
